Fig. 3 — Shelf Lab

Real shelf photos, edited with exact ground truth

A phone photo becomes a planogram. Counterfactual edits change only the pixels inside the changed boxes, so every edit comes with a perfect mask. The same shoppers then judge the render, the photo and the edited photo — and audit gaps are priced by paired simulation.
